description: Source-backed import, FOFRM composition, polygonal sprite meshing, baked-container, client sprite, atlas, cache, and validation contract for FOnline images.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned Engine revision. Projects own asset catalogs, source licensing, visual style, compression policy, resource-pack precedence, animation substitutions, movement tuning, and visible acceptance.
included: the twelve built-in ImageBaker source extensions and their current import behavior
FOFRM fields, aliases, direction sections, nested references, filename options, flattening, offsets, and timing
the versioned private RGBA/mesh frame container, per-pack SpriteInfo index, and output-renaming behavior
default client sprite-factory coverage, SpriteSheet playback, polygon or quad atlas drawing, hit masks, caches, and diagnostics
focused source-anchor, generator, native-test, project-bake, and visible-validation boundaries
excluded: project image catalogs, resource-pack precedence, asset licenses, art direction, quality targets, and acceptance baselines
authoritative movement and the detailed walk/run projection algorithm documented by the Sprite Root Motion guide
particle authoring, model textures, shader effects, GUI layout, fonts, video, and audio formats
a public compatibility promise for the private baked byte stream or unsupported third-party image formats

formats.name: FOFRM descriptor
formats.requirement: FOFRM composes relative image references into one static image, animation, or complete direction sheet and is the preferred authored wrapper for multi-frame or option-bearing sources.
formats.rationale: It is the only built-in text descriptor that can combine sources, add frame deltas, and produce a runtime-loadable .fofrm path.

formats.name: Fallout FRM
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_FRM=ON
formats.requirement: FRM imports big-endian frame timing, offsets, deltas, one or complete direction tables, optional same-basename .pal data, and animated default-palette indices.
formats.rationale: The importer preserves legacy frame geometry while normalizing pixels into the Engine RGBA container.

formats.name: Split directional FRx set
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_FRM=ON
formats.requirement: A .fr0 entry discovers its numbered directional siblings, rejects a gap after direction loading begins, and renames baked output to lowercase .fofrm for critter paths or .frm otherwise.
formats.rationale: The split legacy representation must become one runtime direction sheet with a deterministic output path.

formats.name: RIX image
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_RIX=ON
formats.requirement: RIX imports one opaque indexed image using its embedded palette and emits one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: The format has no authored animation or direction metadata.

formats.name: Arcanum ART
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_ART=ON
formats.requirement: ART uses a 132-byte header with bit depth 8. Flag 0x1 stores one rotation, otherwise eight. All rotation-major tables precede pixel streams; raw frames contain width*height bytes and RLE is bounded by declared frame size. Reject truncated/underfilled/overflowing streams, negative dimensions and baked range overflow. Align selected frame hot spots on one transparent canvas per direction; sequence offsets locate the hot spot and Motion retain movement. Square directions map rotations 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,0; hex maps 1,2,3,5,6,7. art/critter/, art/monster/ and art/unique_npc/ mirror rotations 1–3 from 7–5. Walls/portals shift anchors (-40,+20) for 0,1,6,7; horizontal roof mirrors use the left edge. Present palette fallback, options and category-specific placement follow the imported ART contract. Whole duration fits uint32 milliseconds; zero clock normalizes to 10 fps and positive sub-ms periods to 1 ms. DeltaX/DeltaY remain signed32 during import; only serialized Motion narrows to int16, so FOFRM Motion/FrameMotions can replace wide imported deltas.
formats.rationale: ART direction numbering and frame metadata require format-specific remapping before runtime use.

formats.name: Fallout Tactics SPR
formats.availability: baker only by default; wrap through FOFRM for the stock runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_SPR=ON
formats.requirement: SPR imports named sequences, layered parts, direction remapping, color offsets, repeated-frame sharing, and fixed 10 fps, but the stock DefaultSpriteFactory does not register the .spr extension. BBox/center-derived coordinates are independent frame Offset, including repeated/shared slots; imported Motion is zero.
formats.rationale: Directly baked .spr output cannot be loaded by the default client; a .fofrm wrapper gives the output a registered extension without changing imported pixels.

formats.name: ZAR image
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_ZAR=ON
formats.requirement: ZAR imports one palette-backed raw or RLE image with alpha into one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: ZAR is a single-image legacy container used directly and inside TIL.

formats.name: TIL animation
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_TIL=ON
formats.requirement: TIL imports its nested ZAR frames as a 10 fps single-direction sequence.
formats.rationale: The loader supplies timing because the legacy container exposes a frame list rather than an Engine animation descriptor.

formats.name: MOS or MOSC tiled image
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_MOS=ON
formats.requirement: MOS imports one tiled palette image; MOSC is decompressed first, and palette color 0x00FF00 is made transparent.
formats.rationale: Packed and unpacked files share one extension and normalize to one RGBA frame.

formats.name: BAM or BAMC animation
formats.availability: baker and default runtime; importer requires FO_IMAGE_BAM=ON
formats.requirement: BAM imports one selected cycle or one selected frame, supports packed BAMC input and RLE, reads signed16 centers into independent frame Offset with zero Motion, and treats palette blue 255 as transparent.
formats.rationale: Cycle/frame lookup and palette transparency are part of the legacy format rather than generic sprite behavior.

formats.name: PNG image
formats.requirement: PNG is decoded through libpng, strips 16-bit channels to 8-bit, expands palette/low-bit grayscale/tRNS data, and fills missing alpha with 255 before emitting one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: PNG is the recommended lossless authored source for ordinary project images and transparent sprites.

formats.name: TGA TrueColor image
formats.requirement: TGA supports only raw type 2 or RLE type 10 TrueColor input at 24 or 32 bpp, converts BGR(A) to RGBA, and flips rows bottom-to-top.
formats.rationale: Indexed, grayscale, other bit depths, image IDs, and alternate-origin assumptions are outside the implemented production subset.

descriptor_fields.name: Fps
descriptor_fields.requirement: Root-only positive uint32 Fps replaces timeline defaults; total milliseconds is floor(1000*final_count/Fps) and must provide at least one millisecond per frame. Frame/Frames default to 10 fps; Source preserves imported per-frame timing when no explicit timeline applies. Fps zero and same-section Duration/FrameDurations conflicts fail.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Positive uniform boundaries are computed after final frame selection; runtime uses the resulting per-frame durations.

anchors: FOFRM Fps requires one positive uint32 token

descriptor_fields.name: Derived reference count
descriptor_fields.syntax: Computed from Frame or Frames; no Count key
descriptor_fields.requirement: Count is not an authored key. Each direction derives 1..65535 final frames after grid, flattening and FrameIndices; directions may differ. Source counts as one input reference for transform arrays.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Each referenced source can itself contain multiple frames.

descriptor_fields.name: Offset
descriptor_fields.default: 0 in the root section; inherited from the previous parsed direction when omitted
descriptor_fields.requirement: Offset requires exactly two signed integers; omitted pairs carry forward from root or the previous parsed direction. Invalid pairs and out-of-range values fail.
descriptor_fields.rationale: The parser reuses the current offset pair between directions.

anchors: FOFRM offset pair requires two signed integers

descriptor_fields.name: Effect
descriptor_fields.requirement: Effect is removed and rejected before source resolution, even when empty or pointing to an absent effect. Select render effects at the GUI/map/model/script consumer; the baker does not serialize resource effects. Refusal uses FO_TEMPORARY_COMPAT(FofrmRetiredEffect, "2026-12-31").
descriptor_fields.rationale: A recognized key must have observable semantics or fail explicitly; no dormant EffectName remains.

anchors: FOFRM Effect was removed; select the effect at the resource consumer

descriptor_fields.name: HexDir / SquareDir
descriptor_fields.requirement: The unnamed root always supplies direction 0. Use HexDir 1..5 or SquareDir 1..7 with canonical decimal indexes, never degrees. Named zero and obsolete Dir forms fail before Source. An absent second sequence without an indexed section means one direction; a section without frames fails.
descriptor_fields.rationale: SpriteSheet accepts exactly one direction or GameSettings::MAP_DIR_COUNT directions.

anchors: string section = dir == 0 ? string {} : strex("{} {}", direction_prefix, dir).str();
throw ImageBakerException("FOFRM file invalid apps", fname);

descriptor_fields.name: Frame / Frames
descriptor_fields.requirement: Use only Frame or Frames. Frame is one whole relative path; Frames is a nonempty ordered AnyData String array. Quote paths with spaces; author one reference per continued line and retain repeats.
descriptor_fields.rationale: References are joined with the descriptor directory and then dispatched by the referenced extension.

anchors: FOFRM Frame and Frames are mutually exclusive

descriptor_fields.name: FrameOffsets
descriptor_fields.syntax: FrameOffsets = X Y \ continued pairs; one pair per Frame/Frames reference
descriptor_fields.default: zero pairs when omitted; section-local without inheritance
descriptor_fields.requirement: Optional FrameOffsets requires exactly one signed int32 X Y pair per Frame/Frames reference before flattening, in the same section. AnyData String-array tokens are parsed as strict integer pairs. Each pair adds draw placement to every flattened child frame, plus Offset and child frame placement, without accumulation or changes to imported Motion root-motion deltas. Present empty, malformed, out-of-range or wrong-count lists and lists without references fail. Source uses one reference, including named overrides.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Draw placement has a distinct authored key and storage from imported root-motion deltas; omitted pairs are zero and do not carry between directions.

anchors: static auto ReadOffsetInteger(string_view value, string_view fname, string_view section) -> int32_t

descriptor_fields.name: Size
descriptor_fields.default: source dimensions; root Size defaults every direction
descriptor_fields.requirement: Size requires exactly two strict AnyData String-array integer tokens in 1..65535 and sets exact pixel canvas dimensions for every reference. The root value defaults all directions; named Size is local with no carry. Size and FrameSizes in one section fail.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Physical resampling is separate from draw placement and runtime scale.

anchors: "FOFRM size requires an integer token within uint16 range"
auto sizes = ReadFrameSizes(fofrm, section, names.size(), common_size, fname);
"FOFRM Size and FrameSizes are mutually exclusive in one section"

descriptor_fields.name: FrameSizes
descriptor_fields.syntax: FrameSizes = W H \ continued pairs; one per Frame/Frames reference
descriptor_fields.requirement: FrameSizes is an AnyData String-array of strict integer pairs in 1..65535, one per local Frame/Frames reference before flattening. Each pair sizes every child frame; it is not inherited and overrides inherited root Size. Empty, malformed, wrong-count or reference-free lists fail, including unused sections. Source uses one reference, including named overrides.
descriptor_fields.rationale: List cardinality follows references, not flattened animation frames.

anchors: "FOFRM FrameSizes requires one pair per Frame or Frames reference"

descriptor_fields.name: Nested sequence flattening
descriptor_fields.requirement: Frame/Frames append the selected Main sequence by default, or InputDir, preserving child frame placement and motion while discarding child sequence placement and other directions. Crop/grid/transforms run per reference before flattening; FrameIndices selects the final sequence. Source retains complete collections and per-frame durations. Final frame count and duration are independent per direction.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Each final direction owns its frame table and timeline; child sequence anchors are excluded only during Frame/Frames composition.

descriptor_fields.name: FOFRM whole-sequence timing
descriptor_fields.syntax: Frame/Frames: AnimTicks = 1000 * final_frame_count / Fps; Source: inherited unless Fps is explicit
descriptor_fields.requirement: Frames use positive timespan Duration. Files require whole uint32 ms per frame and direction. Frame/Frames default to 100 ms per final frame; Source inherits selected frame durations, including repeats/grid. Local FrameDurations or Duration replaces root Duration/Fps defaults. Root FrameDurations belongs only to direction0. Uniform boundaries floor(i*Duration/count) preserve the total without zero-length frames.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Wrapping a collection does not lose timing; flattening animated references keeps the requested default cadence.

anchors: FOFRM FrameDurations requires one duration per final frame
Image sequence duration must provide at least one millisecond per frame

descriptor_fields.name: Whole collection Source
descriptor_fields.requirement: Root Source forwards the complete binary or FOFRM collection, preserving directions, sequence/frame offsets, movement and timing. Source and Frame/Frames are mutually exclusive. Root transforms default all existing directions; named sections may override transforms without repeating references. Authored Offset adds to the inherited sequence anchor. Explicit root Fps replaces inherited timing. Alias is rejected with a dated refusal.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Whole-collection inheritance and selected Main-sequence composition have explicit, separate placement and timing rules.

anchors: Source override requires an existing direction
FOFRM Source and Frame/Frames are mutually exclusive

descriptor_fields.name: InputDir
descriptor_fields.requirement: Select an existing input direction before pixels are transformed. For Source, an explicit root InputDir selects a single sequence and preserves its anchor.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameInputDirs
descriptor_fields.requirement: One input-direction index per reference, before flattening. Mutually exclusive with InputDir in the same section.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameIndices
descriptor_fields.requirement: Nonempty AnyData integer list after grid and flattening; permits reordering and repeats, rejects out-of-range indices. Source root defaults every direction; a local list overrides it.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Crop
descriptor_fields.requirement: Crop every input frame before grid: nonnegative origin, positive size, wholly inside its source.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameCrops
descriptor_fields.requirement: One crop rectangle per reference before flattening; replaces inherited Crop, mutually exclusive with local Crop.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Grid
descriptor_fields.requirement: Slice every cropped input frame left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Positive cell dimensions must divide the image exactly; no silent remainder clipping.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Flip
descriptor_fields.requirement: Reflect each grid cell before rotation; literal placement and movement vectors do not change.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameFlips
descriptor_fields.requirement: One flip token per source reference before grid/flattening; mutually exclusive with local Flip.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Rotate
descriptor_fields.requirement: Rotate clockwise after flip and before resize. Quarter turns exchange image axes, not placement or motion axes.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameRotations
descriptor_fields.requirement: One clockwise rotation per source reference; mutually exclusive with local Rotate.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Canvas
descriptor_fields.requirement: After resize, place the image onto an exact transparent uint16-sized canvas. The image must fit completely; use Crop to remove pixels.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameCanvases
descriptor_fields.requirement: One canvas pair per source reference; mutually exclusive with local Canvas.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: CanvasOffset
descriptor_fields.requirement: Nonnegative top-left position within Canvas. Requires an effective Canvas and rejects any clipping. Does not alter Offset.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameCanvasOffsets
descriptor_fields.requirement: One canvas-placement pair per source reference; mutually exclusive with local CanvasOffset.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Motion
descriptor_fields.requirement: Explicit signed int16 pair replaces Motion on every expanded frame; absence preserves imported motion. Independent of Offset/FrameOffsets and bitmap transforms. Legacy Move/FrameMoves keys are refused before Source resolution with FofrmLegacyMotionKeys temporary compatibility marker.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameMotions
descriptor_fields.requirement: One signed int16 motion pair per reference, before flattening. Mutually exclusive with local Motion; never accumulated as placement.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Resample
descriptor_fields.requirement: Nearest copies source channel values. Bilinear uses Q16 pixel centers. Area uses exact rational pixel coverage for downsampling or identity only; upsampling fails. Identity preserves bytes.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: PixelUsage
descriptor_fields.requirement: Color filters premultiplied alpha. Data filters four independent channels. Normal filters signed RGB vectors, normalizes using integer square root, falls back to +Z for zero, and filters alpha independently. Nearest and identity preserve bytes. ColorSpace is forbidden for Data/Normal. Data/Normal preserve all channels through baking: alpha mesh/cropping is disabled, including shared pixel owners.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: ColorSpace
descriptor_fields.requirement: Color-only filtering. Linear decodes through the fixed sRGB linear16 table before premultiplied-alpha interpolation, then encodes to the nearest table entry (ties upward). Encoded retains existing Q16 bytes.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Transform order and source-reference cardinality are explicit.

descriptor_fields.name: Duration
descriptor_fields.requirement: Positive uint32 whole-sequence milliseconds; at least one per final frame. Uniform floor boundaries preserve the total. Root Duration defaults directions; local Duration/FrameDurations overrides it. Same-section Fps/FrameDurations conflicts fail.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Timeline cardinality follows the final logical sequence.

descriptor_fields.name: FrameDurations
descriptor_fields.requirement: AnyData positive uint32 durations, exactly one per final frame after selection; sum fits uint32. Local list only, not per reference and not inherited. Mutually exclusive with same-section Duration/Fps.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Timeline cardinality follows the final logical sequence.

filename_options.name: ART palette, alpha, mirror, and frame selection
filename_options.requirement: Digits select the last requested available palette, T derives alpha from maximum RGB while index zero remains transparent, H/V mirror, and F selects an inclusive ascending or descending clamped frame/range; letters are case-insensitive and unknown characters are ignored.
filename_options.rationale: Options are parsed from the source reference without changing the physical source filename.

filename_options.name: SPR part color offsets and sequence
filename_options.requirement: Zero or more bracket entries set clamped RGB offsets for part 0 other, 1 skin, 2 hair, or 3 armor; an out-of-range part applies the RGB values to all parts, and text after the last bracket selects a sequence case-insensitively (empty selects the first).
filename_options.rationale: The importer composes palette layers and animation selection before writing runtime RGBA frames.

filename_options.name: BAM cycle and frame selection
filename_options.requirement: The integer before '-' selects a cycle and an optional non-negative integer after '-' selects one frame; out-of-range cycle/frame values fall back to zero, while no frame selector imports the whole cycle.
filename_options.rationale: The source can expose many cycles while one resource path needs deterministic output.

filename_options.name: ART rotation selection
filename_options.requirement: The ART loader interprets r= or R= followed by exactly one digit 0..7 as a clockwise rotation from north and emits one direction. Palette selection precedes r=; mirror, alpha and frame options may follow. Invalid values or trailing characters outside those options fail baking. Single-rotation sources reuse their stored frame with placement for the requested rotation. Without the equals sign, r/R remains ignored and a following 0..3 still selects a palette.
filename_options.rationale: Source filename options work identically through Source and ordinary frm references; FOFRM and generic dispatch do not interpret ART-specific options or bypass a registered loader.

baking_rules.name: Scan and targeted modes
baking_rules.requirement: Full scans and targeted requests share the image dependency catalog. Master and on-demand baking retain standalone candidates in the full local cache, including consumed inputs; package export is selected separately by Resources.usage.json. Output discovery and fingerprint cache hits still register actual output names.
baking_rules.rationale: Incremental project builds and one-file rebakes share one baker without treating a skipped target as failure.

baking_rules.name: Case-insensitive extension dispatch
baking_rules.requirement: Source and runtime extension lookup uses get_file_extension(), which returns the extension without its dot and lowercases it.
baking_rules.rationale: Mixed-case extensions resolve to the same registered loader, though projects should still use canonical lowercase paths.

anchors: get_file_extension() noexcept -> strex&; // Extension without dot and lowered

baking_rules.name: Dollar option dispatch
baking_rules.requirement: LoadAny strips text after '$' from the physical filename, passes that suffix to the selected loader, and resolves the source inside the same FileCollection.
baking_rules.rationale: One source file can produce selected or transformed variants through FOFRM references without duplicate binaries.

baking_rules.name: Output path and NewName
baking_rules.requirement: A loader ResolveOutput declaration determines its real published resource path before conversion. A nonempty NewName must agree with that declaration. RawCopy yields an identical output path to Image and cannot republish a consumed source.
baking_rules.rationale: FRM/FRx critter normalization and split-direction aggregation require deterministic renamed resources.

baking_rules.name: Private container header
baking_rules.requirement: Sprite resource v3 begins with uint8 magic43, uint8 version3 and uint8 direction count. Each direction then writes uint16 frame count and uint32 total milliseconds; footer magic43 terminates the exact byte span. Runtime rejects older versions; rebuild baker, clients and metadata together and force-rebake all images. MigrationRule Version advances74→75.
baking_rules.rationale: The shared SpriteResource decoder validates the versioned framing before any client or tool consumes pixels or mesh data.

baking_rules.name: Direction records
baking_rules.requirement: Each direction owns 1..65535 frames and a positive uint32 total equal to its frame-duration sum. Counts and durations may differ by direction. Sequence anchor plus logical frame offset becomes an int32 X/Y baked placement; root motion stays int16 and independent.
baking_rules.rationale: Per-frame offsets preserve screen placement when polygon geometry changes the serialized canvas independently for each direction and animation frame.

baking_rules.name: Concrete and shared frame records
baking_rules.requirement: Slots write positive uint32 whole-ms duration, int32 X/Y placement, int16 X/Y motion and uint8 shared flag. Shared: backward uint16 pixel index. Concrete: uint16 W/H, RGBA8, mesh. Sharing keeps only pixels/size/geometry; placement/motion/time stay local. FrameShot Size/Motion/Offset are signed32 pairs; output checks Size >=0 and uint16, Motion int16.
baking_rules.rationale: The record preserves logical placement and lighting coordinates while avoiding transparent texture rows and submitting indexed silhouettes; repeated frames still reuse the original payload.

baking_rules.name: Per-pack SpriteInfo index
baking_rules.requirement: SpriteInfo/<PackName>.foinfo version2 describes published root outputs only. DirectionFrameCounts and flattened FrameDurationsMs replace global frame count/duration. Positive durations and uint32 sum are checked per direction; shared slots require equal pixel dimensions while own placement/motion/timing may differ. Private successful-output snapshots retain complete entries for full/lazy index recovery without decoding current pixels. A pack without roots publishes an empty index before dependent bakers run; stale metadata must not survive removal of its last root.
baking_rules.rationale: Common EngineMetadata answers animation queries without decoding pixels; full and on-demand baking maintain the same root metadata.

baking_rules.name: Optional polygonal sprite mesh
baking_rules.requirement: Resolve and validate the complete SpriteMesh setting group for every image bake, including when SpriteMesh.Enabled is false: AlphaThreshold is 0..254, MaxTriangles is positive, and AreaSavingsWeight is finite and non-negative. When enabled, build deterministic alpha-thresholded candidates within that triangle budget, score saved original-frame area against submitted triangles, retain only validated coverage, crop selected mesh canvases to exact geometry bounds, and preserve the logical root through the serialized frame offset.
baking_rules.rationale: The opt-in path reduces transparent overdraw and texture area without clipping visible pixels or changing gameplay placement; unsafe or unprofitable candidates remain quads and empty masks remain explicit empty geometry.

baking_rules.name: Per-file work and aggregate failure
baking_rules.requirement: Graph validation fails before conversion with the root and dependency chain. Import failures preserve source path, filename options, input size and original exception. Selected asynchronous conversions are reported individually and any error prevents new dependency snapshots for that batch.
baking_rules.rationale: A full scan reports all independently failing image resources in one run without silently succeeding.

anchors: throw ImageBakerException("Errors during images baking", errors, first_error)
throw ImageBakerException("Image import failed", fname, opt, input_size, ex.what())

baking_rules.name: FOFRM physical resampling
baking_rules.requirement: Size/FrameSizes resample RGBA by pixel-center bilinear filtering in premultiplied-alpha space before meshing and atlas upload. The identity path preserves every pixel; an empty source yields a transparent target. Offset, FrameOffsets, child frame offsets and imported Motion keep their pixel units. Missing size keys preserve existing bytes, timing and frame order. Transparent resampled pixels have zero RGB; identity keeps hidden RGB.
baking_rules.rationale: Transparent RGB must not bleed into visible edges; resizing does not rewrite authored anchors or root motion.

baking_rules.name: Mounted source dependency graph
baking_rules.requirement: Build one graph from explicitly mounted sources before IncludePatterns/ExcludePatterns filter output candidates. Relative Frame/Frames/Source references share the native ImageRecipe parser; filename options belong to an edge. Later mounted pack winners resolve logical paths. Reject missing dependencies, cycles and chains deeper than 64 FOFRM nodes. Track FRM palettes and FRX directions, including absent optional inputs.
baking_rules.rationale: Source availability and publication are different decisions; the same immutable graph serves full, discovery and lazy baking.

baking_rules.name: Only recipe roots are published
baking_rules.requirement: FOFRM inputs remain readable for composition. The dependency graph suppresses consumed standalone candidates in its root-only plan; the complete local cache also exposes them for independent Resource references and model textures. Flattened outputs have no runtime export edge to their inputs: unreferenced copies are excluded from Resources.usage.json.
baking_rules.rationale: Intermediate assets must not increase shipped size or bypass a declared resize/transformation recipe.

baking_rules.name: Transitive content fingerprints
baking_rules.requirement: Hash each reachable input once per graph snapshot with BLAKE2b-512. Include mount identity, canonical path, input bytes, child digests, optional-input absence, recipe options, build/baking contract and SpriteMesh settings. Detect byte changes with unchanged size/mtime. Publish a private per-output snapshot and metadata entry only after successful output writes; missing/corrupt snapshots rebuild. Cache hits avoid pixel conversion and remain in the expected-output manifest. Reindex/lazy also validate fingerprints and the declaring output pack.
baking_rules.rationale: Editing a source does not require touching its FOFRM descriptor or forcing a full bake.

runtime_rules.name: Default factory extension boundary
runtime_rules.requirement: DefaultSpriteFactory registers every built-in ImageBaker extension except spr; direct .spr paths need a custom factory or, normally, an authored .fofrm wrapper.
runtime_rules.rationale: Bake support and stock runtime path support are separate extension registries.

runtime_rules.name: Baked-container decoding
runtime_rules.requirement: ReadSpriteResource rejects unsupported versions, malformed durations/counts, invalid backward shared references, truncated pixels/mesh and trailing data. DefaultSpriteFactory creates an atlas image for one frame/one direction or a SpriteSheet with per-direction timelines; shared copies override their own placement and movement.
runtime_rules.rationale: Source decoders are baker-only and are not deployed as runtime image parsers.

runtime_rules.name: Single-frame behavior
runtime_rules.requirement: A one-frame one-direction resource becomes AtlasSprite and applies the resolved concrete-frame draw offset; serialized Motion remains metadata because there is no SpriteSheet frame-displacement surface.
runtime_rules.rationale: Motion matters only when a sheet consumer selects and interprets animation frames.

runtime_rules.name: Direction and playback state
runtime_rules.requirement: SpriteSheet durations/ends and GetDuration/GetFrameDurations use timespan; wire values are positive uint32 ms. Directions preserve phase; direction0 is independent. Copies retain timing and reset playback. Uniform constructors split ns; AdvanceTime keeps sub-ms time with continuous forward/reverse phase. Explicit native/script-created zero-duration sequences retain manual normalized frame selection and do not play automatically; each timeline is entirely zero or entirely positive.
runtime_rules.rationale: Animation state is client presentation state and each direction owns a parallel frame sheet.

runtime_rules.name: Sprite offsets and frame motion
runtime_rules.requirement: Concrete/shared frames retain ordinary sprite offsets to the root in SpriteSheet::_sprOffset and Motion per-frame visual motion deltas in _sprMotion. SetFrame(offset, motion) assigns each input to its matching field. CreateSpriteSequence retains original shared atlas sprites with independent offsets and motions arrays in that order. GetSpriteFrameOffset reads ordinary offsets; GetSpriteFrameMotion reads deltas. CritterHexView derives cumulative displacement, distance-driven frame selection, cycle phase and visual _offsAnim compensation from motion deltas against logical HexOffset and independent extra displacement. These presentation values do not drive entity movement. Projects own first/last selection, cumulative displacement, filename rules and sequence splices.
runtime_rules.rationale: Per-frame visual displacement must remain separate from image anchors and authoritative world movement.

runtime_rules.name: Atlas upload, polygon draw, border, and hit mask
runtime_rules.requirement: Positive-size RGBA frames are placed in the requested AtlasType, uploaded with duplicated one-pixel filtering edges, and converted to a SpriteHitValue hit mask. Ordinary full-image draws submit the baked indexed silhouette when present; crops, tiled and padded draws, fonts, blits, model sprites, and particles retain rectangular paths.
runtime_rules.rationale: Mesh geometry changes fill and submission cost without changing atlas pixels, picking, logical scaling, or specialized rectangular rendering contracts.

runtime_rules.name: Copyable sprite cache identity
runtime_rules.requirement: Copyable sprites are cached by hashed path plus AtlasType; every load, including the first, returns MakeCopy. SpriteSheet clocks and frame tables are independent; AtlasSprite retains shared atlas pixels/geometry.
runtime_rules.rationale: Independent animation state must not mutate the cached prototype, and different atlas classes cannot share placement blindly.

runtime_rules.name: Missing-path memoization
runtime_rules.requirement: Missing paths, absent extensions, unknown factories, and factory load failures are memoized by path in _nonFoundSprites; CleanupSpriteCache does not clear that set.
runtime_rules.rationale: ResourceManager preserves failures during cleanup; ForgetFailedSprite or InvalidateSpriteResource explicitly enables a retry after mounted sources change.

validation_rules.name: Nonempty FOFRM references
validation_rules.requirement: A recipe uses exactly one nonempty root Source or nonempty Frame/Frames composition. Source is root-only and excludes Frame/Frames in every section. All modes validate names, offsets and sizes before producing an output.
validation_rules.rationale: A descriptor must resolve at least one source reference before a runtime frame table can exist.

validation_rules.name: Complete direction tables
validation_rules.requirement: Frame/Frames composition requires one unnamed sequence or the complete active-geometry indexed direction table; even a later section without direction1 fails before resolution. Source permits overrides of existing directions without repeated references. Final direction counts and durations may differ, but every timeline must be valid.
validation_rules.rationale: Every direction sheet shares one frame-count and timing header.

validation_rules.name: Safe nested shared-frame materialization
validation_rules.requirement: Resolve shared pixel chains before composition, rejecting invalid indices and cycles. Materialization copies pixels/dimensions/pixel-preservation flags while retaining the logical slot placement, motion and duration. Legacy SPR explicitly copies its former aliased metadata when constructing slots.
validation_rules.rationale: Shared slots own placement, movement and time; materialization copies concrete pixels without replacing that metadata.

validation_rules.name: Exact RGBA payload size
validation_rules.requirement: Reject every concrete frame whose byte payload is not exactly width times height times four.
validation_rules.rationale: The client reads a fixed RGBA8 byte count without a separate payload-length field.

anchors: Animation frame RGBA payload size does not match frame dimensions

validation_rules.name: Supported TGA subset
validation_rules.requirement: Use no image ID, bottom-left orientation, TrueColor type 2 or 10, and 24 or 32 bpp; indexed/grayscale/other inputs are rejected or outside the implemented orientation assumptions.
validation_rules.rationale: The loader consumes the fixed header directly, then always flips rows and does not branch on descriptor origin.

validation_rules.name: Malformed decoder inputs
validation_rules.requirement: Keep focused failure coverage for corrupt PNG, TGA, FRM/FRx/RIX/ART/ZAR/TIL/MOS/BAM, SPR, and nested FOFRM inputs.
validation_rules.rationale: Legacy binary parsers must fail deterministically instead of emitting truncated runtime containers.

validation_rules.name: Runtime container guards
validation_rules.requirement: Require v3 magic/version, positive per-direction counts/times, positive slot durations with checked sum, positive uint16 concrete dimensions, valid backward pixel references, valid mesh/pixel bounds and exact footer/end. SpriteInfo requires schema2 and matching flat array sizes.
validation_rules.rationale: Corrupt baked bytes must not reach atlas allocation or animation updates.

validation_rules.name: Nonzero per-frame duration
validation_rules.requirement: Positive logical-frame durations and checked uint32 totals eliminate division by zero for short animations. Explicit Duration below final frame count fails. Raw legacy zero clocks normalize to 10 fps; positive sub-ms periods normalize to 1 ms. Source preserves imported timelines; normalized phase drives forward/reverse/loop playback and direction switches.
validation_rules.rationale: SpriteSheet advances normalized phase by elapsed/whole duration and selects frames using cumulative positive duration boundaries.

anchors: Image sequence duration must provide at least one millisecond per frame

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project visual gate
validation_rules.requirement: After native and documentation checks, rebake the embedding project and inspect changed dimensions, alpha edges, mirrors, directions, cadence, offsets, hit masks, and relevant client profiles in a visible scene.
validation_rules.rationale: Parser and container tests cannot prove art framing, filtering, gait, or project resource-pack selection.

validation_rules.name: Canonical FOFRM names
validation_rules.requirement: Before source resolution, validate the unnamed root (direction 0), active-geometry nonzero HexDir/SquareDir sections, exact PascalCase keys and field applicability. Source and Fps are root-only. Alias and Effect are refused with dated migration markers. Old Dir forms, named zero, Count, old frame/delta keys and unknown names fail; there is no fallback.
validation_rules.rationale: Unmigrated names and misspellings must fail baking instead of silently applying defaults or bypassing checks through Source.
